notes.title: FIRST UPDATE!
notes.content:
[b][h1]Hey folks![/h1][/b]

I want to thank everyone for your comments and suggestions. Thanks to you, I have gathered a lot of feedback that will be considered in the future. Below is a list of completed and planned work.

[h2][b]Fixed:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Save progress.
[*] Sound disappearing.
[*] Missing Max's story.
[*] Missing Max in heaven.
[*] Overlapping cinematics.
[*] Long loading times.
[*] Game freezes.
[*] Game lock during play.
[*] Getting stuck.
[*] Bug quest in the winter location (cave).
[*] Main quest with the bowl.
[*] Main gate – now, to enter heaven, you first need to talk to the Bug, who will open the main gate.
[/list]

At the moment, there are still aspects of the game that I continue to work on and improve, but all known critical errors that could lead to game locks have been fixed. If you encounter any issues while playing, please let me know.

[h2][b]Planned work:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] The next step is to go through each location and make numerous changes based on players feedback (visuals, level design, bugs). Updates will be released for each level individually, with their own list of completed work.
[*] New location! Another location called “Maze” is planned for the game, where you will meet another character. [/list]

Thank you all for your patience and the help you have provided. See you soon.

[b]Best.[/b]

notes.title: THE GAME IS OUT!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Good day, friends![/b][/h1]

I am excited to announce that my game [b]"Heaven's Paws"[/b] has officially been released, and now I can finally share this news with you! It's been a week since the release, and during this time, I've received a lot of feedback that has helped me to improve the game. I understand that not everything went smoothly, and want to apologize for any issues you may have encountered.

But I'm not stopping there! [b]"Heaven's Paws"[/b] is not just a game; it’s part of my live, which I want to share with you. I am continuously working to enhance the project, adding new features and content to ensure that every moment you spend in the game brings you joy. Your feedback and suggestions are incredibly valuable to me, and I am grateful for your support!

Stay tuned for updates, as there’s much more exciting content on the way! Thank you for playing [b]"Heaven's Paws"[/b]!

[h2][b]Much Love <3[/b][/h2]
